about: Images scripts/skills-eval/replay_fixtures.py writes into the eval instance's Agent folder before the evals run, with the sha256 of each. The evals start from these files; no document fixture is needed. The profile eval needs a Film-Inspired profile without depending on Adobe's library: the replay writes a synthetic Look profile (the committed film-prophoto test fixture under a new name and group) and the film-profile fixture imports it into the instance.

fixtures.description: Imports the synthetic Film-Inspired profile into the instance's profile library, so list_profiles finds it.
